title: Two OCR Failures on One e-Ink Card — and Why Showing Your Working Beats Hiding It
summary: A mock e-ink credential fails to verify for two reasons: Apple's OCR reads 'Wolf' as 'wolf', and two whole claim lines go missing before the hash. A follow-up run pins the second bug to an OCR reading-order scramble — and the app's transparency is what surfaced and solved both.

title: Verification Speed and Trust in Document Authentication
summary: Camera-and-OCR verification takes a few seconds — fine for a receipt, wrong for an urgent claim. In-page, QR, and browser-native verification each trade latency against a different trust problem.
